genaya.description: Genaya Connect is the hosted MCP server of Genaya, an operations app for service businesses: ask about appointments, clients, invoices, calls and tasks, and prepare texts, emails and other changes that run only after the member confirms them. Nothing runs locally; Claude Code opens a browser sign-in (OAuth 2.1 with PKCE) on first use, and every call acts as that member with their Genaya permissions. Genaya is a paid product with no free plan; every plan starts with a 14-day free trial.
